lancaster_plotholder.text: Brindle Bank. Good soil, a view of the Lune on a clear day and slugs on a wet one.
Keep it stocked with the right seeds for the season and the plot looks after itself, mostly.

lancaster_neighbour.text: The show is on in September. I have been second to Doreen for eleven years, and I'll take the cup this time.
Parsnips taste better after a frost. Leave them in, it is the one time laziness pays.
